profile_text.body:
Cisco is a publicly traded worldwide technology company (NASDAQ: CSCO, CIK 0000858877) that develops networking, security, and software products and services. The company describes itself as a worldwide technology leader and offers solutions spanning AI-optimized networking, programmable silicon for AI workloads, data center modernization, and security embedded across network layers. Its site also highlights autonomous network operations driven by policy-bound agents, and a product called Cisco IQ, described as a unified AI-powered experience delivering real-time insights, troubleshooting, automation, and agent-driven guidance for support and professional services.

On the AI product side, Cisco offers Cisco Webex AI, categorized as a meetings and knowledge tool, with capabilities including meeting intelligence, real-time translation, noise removal, and enterprise security. The company's broader AI infrastructure positioning emphasizes purpose-built silicon optimized for hyperscalers, service providers, enterprises, and data centers, as well as networking designed to run AI workloads faster and at global scale. The site notes that the McLaren Mastercard Formula 1 Team uses Cisco networking and security for AI workloads processing race data across 24 races worldwide.

No litigation cases or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for Cisco at this time.
